purpose: Express that an action is necessary.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I have to get up early tomorrow.
I have to take my medicine.
restrictions: The negative condition literally presents an unacceptable failure to act.
mistake: Despite the negative verb form, the whole expression means the action is required.

segments.role: Express that an action is necessary. ない-form + といけない.
